passages.text: This is the message that was revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.
passages.sermon:
Isaiah was a prophet.
Isaiah was the son of Amoz.
God gave Isaiah a message.
This message was about Judah and Jerusalem.
In the last days, God will act.
The mountain of the house of the LORD will stand firm.
This mountain will be the highest of all mountains.
It will be raised above all the hills.
All nations will come to this mountain.
People from every nation will stream to it.
passages.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אָמ֑וֹץ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֖א מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: And many peoples will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Many peoples will come.
They will say, “Let us go up to the mountain of the LORD.
Let us go to the house of the God of Jacob.
He will teach us His ways.
We will walk in His paths.
The law will go out from Zion.
The word of the LORD will go out from Jerusalem.”
passages.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor train anymore for war.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will judge between the nations.
He will decide disputes for many peoples.
People will beat their swords into plowshares.
They will turn their spears into pruning hooks.
No nation will lift up a sword against another nation.
No one will learn war anymore.
passages.original: וְשָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהוֹכִ֖יחַ לְעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל־ גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־ יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The house of Jacob is the people of Israel.
God calls the house of Jacob.
God says, "Come."
God says, "Let us walk."
God says, "Let us walk in the light of the LORD."
The light of the LORD means God's truth and guidance.
God invites His people to follow His ways.
passages.original: בֵּ֖ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּא֥וֹר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
passages.sermon:
God abandoned His people.
His people are the house of Jacob.
God left them because they followed foreign ways.
They filled themselves with influences from the east.
They practiced soothsaying like the Philistines.
They made agreements with the children of foreigners.
passages.original: כִּ֣י נָטַ֗שְׁתָּה עַמְּךָ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֤י מָלְאוּ֙ מִקֶּ֔דֶם וְעֹֽנְנִ֖ים כַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּבְיַלְדֵ֥י נָכְרִ֖ים יַשְׂפִּֽיקוּ׃

passages.text: Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.
passages.sermon:
The people of Jacob live in a land.
Their land contains much silver.
Their land contains much gold.
Their treasures have no limit.
Their land contains many horses.
Their chariots have no limit.
passages.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְאֹצְרֹתָ֑יו וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ סוּסִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְמַרְכְּבֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel fill their land with idols.
They make these idols with their own hands.
They use their fingers to shape them.
They bow down to these idols.
They worship what they themselves have made.
passages.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א אַרְצ֖וֹ אֱלִילִ֑ים לְמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֔וּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: So mankind is brought low, and man is humbled— do not forgive them!
passages.sermon: God brings mankind low.\r\nGod humbles every person.\r\nDo not forgive these people.
passages.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־ אִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־ תִּשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and majestic.
People feel terror because of the LORD.
Go into the rocks.
Hide in the dust.
Do this because you fear the LORD.
Do this because of the splendor of His majesty.
passages.original: בּ֣וֹא בַצּ֔וּר וְהִטָּמֵ֖ן בֶּֽעָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵי֙ פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֔ה וּמֵהֲדַ֖ר גְּאֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The proud look of man will be humbled, and the loftiness of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
passages.sermon:
Isaiah speaks about the Day of the LORD.
On that day, the LORD will act with power and majesty.
God will humble every proud person.
God will bring down every lofty man.
No one will stand above others.
The LORD alone will be exalted on that day.
No one else will share His glory.
passages.original: עֵינֵ֞י גַּבְה֤וּת אָדָם֙ שָׁפֵ֔ל וְשַׁ֖ח ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ס

passages.text: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty, against all that is exalted— it will be humbled— against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up, against all the oaks of Bashan, against all the tall mountains, against all the high hills, against every high tower, against every fortified wall, against every ship of Tarshish, and against every stately vessel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God has a day of judgment.
On that day, God will act against all who are proud.
God will act against all who are lofty.
God will humble everything that is exalted.
God will come against all the tall cedars of Lebanon.
God will come against all the high oaks of Bashan.
God will come against every tall mountain.
God will come against every high hill.
God will come against every high tower.
God will come against every strong, fortified wall.
God will come against every ship from Tarshish.
God will come against every beautiful, stately vessel.
passages.original: כִּ֣י י֞וֹם לַיהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־ גֵּאֶ֖ה וָרָ֑ם וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ נִשָּׂ֥א וְשָׁפֵֽל׃ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ אַרְזֵ֣י הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן הָרָמִ֖ים וְהַנִּשָּׂאִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ אַלּוֹנֵ֥י הַבָּשָֽׁן׃ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ הֶהָרִ֣ים הָרָמִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ הַגְּבָע֥וֹת הַנִּשָּׂאֽוֹת׃ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ מִגְדָּ֣ל גָּבֹ֑הַ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ חוֹמָ֥ה בְצוּרָֽה׃ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ שְׂכִיּ֥וֹת הַחֶמְדָּֽה׃

passages.text: So the pride of man will be brought low, and the loftiness of men will be humbled; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day, and the idols will vanish completely.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God alone will be exalted in that day.
God will humble the pride of man.
God will bring down the loftiness of men.
Idols will vanish completely.
passages.original: וְשַׁח֙ גַּבְה֣וּת הָאָדָ֔ם וְשָׁפֵ֖ל ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ וְהָאֱלִילִ֖ים כָּלִ֥יל יַחֲלֹֽף׃

passages.text: Men will flee to caves in the rocks and holes in the ground, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and majestic.
He will rise to shake the earth.
Men will feel terror because of the LORD.
Men will see the splendor of His majesty.
Men will run away from Him.
They will hide in caves in the rocks.
They will hide in holes in the ground.
passages.original: וּבָ֙אוּ֙ בִּמְעָר֣וֹת צֻרִ֔ים וּבִמְחִלּ֖וֹת עָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold— the idols they made to worship.
passages.sermon:
On that day, men will throw away their idols.
These idols are made of silver and gold.
Men made these idols to worship them.
Men will cast these idols to the moles and the bats.
passages.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יַשְׁלִ֣יךְ הָאָדָ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת אֱלִילֵ֣י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָֽשׂוּ־ לוֹ֙ לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לַחְפֹּ֥ר פֵּר֖וֹת וְלָעֲטַלֵּפִֽים׃

passages.text: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and crevices in the cliffs, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord.
God is majestic and powerful.
God will rise to shake the earth.
People will feel terror because of the Lord.
People will see the splendor of God's majesty.
People will run away from God.
People will hide in caverns in the rocks.
People will hide in crevices in the cliffs.
passages.original: לָבוֹא֙ בְּנִקְר֣וֹת הַצֻּרִ֔ים וּבִסְעִפֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
passages.sermon:
Do not trust in man.
Man only has breath in his nostrils.
Man is weak and limited.
Man cannot save you.
Man is not important compared to God.
passages.original: חִדְל֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְשָׁמָ֖ה בְּאַפּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ בַמֶּ֥ה נֶחְשָׁ֖ב הֽוּא׃פ
